Deadbog are a four piece noise pop band based in Cork, formed in summer 2018 by friends Danny O’Shea (guitars and vocals) and Luke Daly (drums).
After a number of gigs as a two piece, Rory Burke (guitar) and JJ Lee (bass) completed the line up.
Musically, Deadbog can be described as a mix of soft, washy, reverb drenched vocals sitting in a mix of loud, distorted guitars, wall of sound noise and hard-hitting drums taking influence from shoegaze, dream pop and post rock.
